extracted.intended_audience: merchants, brokers, and customs/port officials handling trade between Venice and Mediterranean ports (historical)
extracted.subtask_description: A historical Venetian tariff / tariffa giving unit conversions, allowed sale measures, valuation rules, tare/deduction rules, and port-specific trading conventions for many commodities (spices, metals, textiles, foodstuffs) between Venice and other ports (Alexandria, Candia, Negroponte, Tripoli, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Market-specific unit equivalence / conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies how quantities measured in foreign ports convert into Venetian measures and vice-versa (e.g., how many moggia/cantare/pefo/ruotoli of a given place equal Venice units).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples throughout: "uno ... di vinegia fa in alexandria pefi.78.5.di migliareri", "100 di candia tornano i uinegia...", "il cento delle cane torna in uinegia bsaccia" — the schedule gives per-commodity equivalences between local measures (cantare, moggio, braccia, ruotoli, libbre, migliaio, picchi, botte, anfora) and Venetian units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted sale measures per commodity
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines the legal/accepted units by which specific commodities are to be sold in particular markets (e.g., 'a cantare', 'a moggio', 'a pefo', 'a ruotoli', 'a libbre', 'a migliaio', 'a picchi', 'a botte', 'anfora').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated formulations: "fi uendono a cantare", "a moggio", "a pefo", "a ruotoli"; e.g. spices and small goods often 'a cantare' or 'a ruotoli', wines in 'botte' or 'anfora', textiles by 'braccia' or 'canne'. The tariff lists per-commodity the allowed sale unit for each port.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tare (tara) and container deduction rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for deducting tare (weight/volume of packaging/containers) and for applying percentage or per-unit deductions when converting or valuing goods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases and examples: "tare per la botte o caratello", "per cento e ogni libbie cèto tre fono i famagofta" and references to 'tara' for botte, caratelli, giara, ruotoli. The schedule prescribes how much to subtract (by percent, per libbra, per container) when converting or pricing packaged goods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Port- and commodity-specific pricing/valuation in currency and coin units
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies monetary valuation rules and exchange — which currency or coin unit (marco, ducato, fiorino, carati, perle, etc.) is used to value or settle transactions for goods from particular ports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "marco... si rinegia fa in...", "marco vno di vinegia to2na i alexandria pefi.", "oro filato fi uéde in candia al pefo di uinegia" — the text gives exchange/valuation examples and which coin/weight is applied for settlement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packaging and container-count standards (botte, anfora, carica, cantare)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for how many items constitute a container unit and how containers are treated in conversions (e.g., how many botte/anfore per carica, how many cantare per carriage, counts per botte/anfora).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "la detta botte ... torna in uinegia", "una carica... torna in vinegia una carica", references to 'carica', 'cantare', 'botte', 'anfora' and specific numeric conversions and remarks on how many containers equal specified Venetian units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commodity-specific conversion and treatment rules
rubrics_metrics.description: For each class of commodity (spices, metals, textiles, foodstuffs, leather, etc.) the schedule gives conversion, sale-unit, and valuation rules tailored to that commodity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple passages: e.g., metals: "Rame: ferro: piombo: stagno ... si uedono ...", spices: "pepe... cannella... lacca...", textiles: "tela... panni... braccia... canne"; each entry lists how that specific commodity is measured/sold and converted between ports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements regarding condition/quality (no decomposed goods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stipulates that goods must not be decomposed/rotten and that decomposed goods affect payment/acceptance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wording example: "le mercaderìe debono elTere decomperatod e pero niéte non paga..." — indicates that mercantile goods must be sound; otherwise they may not be paid for or accepted at standard rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Textile measurement conventions (braccia, canne, picchi, ruotoli)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules for measuring and converting textiles: counts in braccia, canne, picchi, ruotoli with how many of each unit equals Venetian measures and how they return to Venice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "canne una ... torna in uinegia braccia", "ruotoli ... il ruotolo viene a elTere ...", many entries specifying the number of braccia/canne/picchi per Venetian measure and per foreign port.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bulk commodity conversion factors (grano, biade, vino, olio, sale)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conversion and sale rules for bulk foodstuffs — grain, other cereals, wine, oil, salt — including which bulk-unit is used and cross-port equivalences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "grano ... fa in vinegia ... moggio ...", "vino fi uede in patrao a mirro ...", repeated items listing how many moggia/cantare/anfore correspond between ports for staples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precious metals and gems measurement/valuation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for measuring and valuing gold, silver, pearls and other precious items: carati, perle counts, and how they convert/are priced between ports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "una perle ... Di vinegia ...", "oro filato ... in candia al pefo di uinegia", references to carati, perle, and per-unit valuation norms and conversion rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Port-specific tariff/market rules (negropónte, candia, alexandria, tripoli, tibilia, valencia, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each port has its own set of tariff rules, allowed measures, and conversion factors — the schedule enumerates these port-by-port.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections labeled with port references (e.g., "vinegia co negropóte.ca.86", "uendcn in candia...", "uno ... in alexandria...", "vinegia con valeca.ca.126") list per-port exceptions or specific conversions and valuations.
